Law 2466 of 2025 art. 21 converted the apprenticeship into a special fixed-term LABOUR contract, regulated by Decree 0223 of 5 March 2026. Electronic payroll TipoContrato = 4; PILA worker type 12 (lectiva) or 19 (productiva).
Law 1221 of 2008 as amended by Law 2466 of 2025 arts. 52-54. No reporting difference; the electronic payroll carries a dedicated Teletrabajo earning element (NIE158).

IN SCOPE and frequently mis-configured. Withheld at the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the GROSS, with no art. 388 depuration, until the 183-day residence test is met (DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026). See the resident / non-resident block in the Report Matrix.
Casilla 129, where an employee's withholding is corrected downward in a later month.
Casillas 131-135. Owned by the client's tax function.
The universal Colombian rule - payment o credit in account. Applies to the electronic payroll (DIAN Resolution 000013 of 2021 art. 3), to Form 350, to Form 220 and to Format 2276.
Foreign-source income, not taxable in Colombia, no withholding and nothing to declare (DIAN Official letter 28380 of 2019).
By a corrective return carrying casilla 25 (correction code) and casilla 26 (the form number being corrected). The minimum penalty is 10 UVT of the year the ORIGINAL return was filed.

The casilla 4 form number of the return, or of the administrative act, being corrected. This is the link that lets DIAN supersede the earlier filing rather than treat this one as a duplicate.

Principal economic-activity code from casilla 46 of the RUT, chosen from the codes in DIAN Resoluciones 000114 of 21 December 2020, 001232 of 16 September 2022 and 000086 of 24 May 2023. THE SAME ART. 114-1 EXONERATION that drives this casilla also drives PILA file tipo 1 field 33 and Record Tipo 2 field 76 - the employer that is exonerated from employer health, SENA and ICBF for employees under 10 SMMLV is the employer that self-withholds here.

THE PRINCIPAL PAYROLL CASILLA ON THE WITHHOLDING SIDE. Sum of the income-tax withholding at source actually practised on work income paid to natural persons in the calendar month, across EVERY payroll run of the entity in that month (not only the regular run), in whole pesos, then rounded once to the nearest 1,000. Sources in the client's payroll: WT 2552 'Income Tax (employee)' (Deductions), plus WT 21330 'Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical)' for the employees whose WT 2552 line is a zero-value Non Cash item and whose deduction is booked on WT 21330 (6 of 261 employees in the Sep-2026 run). Together they reconcile exactly to the Base of Withholding column V 'WITHOLDING TAX WITH CONTRIBUTION' (per employee, 2552 = V for 255 of 261 and 21330 = V for the other 6; run total 1,468,500,598). The same per-employee amount is reported as RetencionFuente (NIE177) in the client's electronic payroll documents of the same pay group and run (261 of 261 employees; total 1,468,500,598). Do NOT use column X 'WITHOLDING TAX WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION'. The Base of Withholding and the G2N cover one pay group and one payroll run only (G2N title 'Pay Group(s)' = CO - Monthly): in Sep-2026 the Accumulated Report holds a further 144,635,503 of WT 2552 for 97 IDs not in that run (93 paid weekly / exceptional advances WT 61100 'Weekly advance' / WT 62838 'Exceptional Advance', 42,067,461; 4 paid termination or settlement items such as WT 62116 / 62110 / 62203 / 62115, 102,568,042), so the casilla is built from every pay group and every payroll run of the month, not from one report. Do not use the report 'Payroll id' as the run key: the same run carries a different Payroll id in the Base of Withholding and in the G2N / Master Data reports. [DECISION PENDING - see Query to RA] (a) whether CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING (column Y, = X - V, present only for employees with AFC or voluntary-pension contributions and not deducted by any wage type) is excluded from this casilla; (b) whether withholding booked on WT 21129 (Terminations), 25832 (Stock awards vesting), 25833 (IC Local Country) and 25834 (Hypothetical - IC Foreign Country), and on the theoretical-tax WTs 21114 (Theoretical income Tax-5011) and 21619 (Theoretical Income Tax - Ajuste - 5035), enters here in the month it is practised - the client's electronic-payroll mapping reports all of them as RetencionFuente (NIE177), but that is client practice, not confirmation that 25834, 21114 and 21619 are withholding actually practised; (c) whether withholding on the employees withheld at a flat 20% of gross income (client Tax Procedure 3; inferred from the rate to be the ET art. 408 non-resident withholding - no report labels them non-resident) is reported here or in casillas 111/112. Must reconcile to the sum of RetencionFuente (NIE177) across every electronic payroll document for the same month, after the nearest-1,000 rounding. It is one of the forty-two casillas summed into casilla 130.

Withholding after treaty relief. Where the treaty assigns taxing rights to the residence state the rate may be reduced to nil. Mercans applies treaty relief ONLY on written client instruction supported by a residence certificate.

For a NON-RESIDENT EMPLOYEE the two relevant concepts are: SIN AGREEMENT concept 5, 'Services y compensacion por personal services'; CON AGREEMENT concept 24, 'Employment income' - expressly 'employment income de cualquier naturaleza en relacion con un empleo'. Concept 25 covers directors' fees and concept 27 pensions. NOTE the documentation conflict recorded in the RA query column.

Country of TAX RESIDENCE of the non-resident payee (for a treaty claim, the country on the residence certificate), expressed with the country code required by the DIAN Form 350 sheet-2 list (code standard to be confirmed by RA - see Query to RA). Do not derive it from Nationality. If the HR address country (Master Data 'Country') is used as a fallback it must be normalised to one consistent form (the client data holds 'co' and 'cr' alongside 'CO' and 'CR') and converted to the DIAN code; note that Nationality and address Country name different countries for 15 employees, so neither attribute is tax residence by itself. Where 'Treaty status' (casilla 141) = CON CONVENIO the country must be one with a treaty in force. Colombia's treaty network in force includes Spain, Chile, Switzerland, Canada, Mexico, South Korea, Portugal, India, the Czech Republic, the United Kingdom, France, Italy and Japan, plus Andean Community Decision 578.

Fees paid to a natural person under the art. 383 table can straddle 77 / 93 and 79 / 95; the boundary is a client decision, documented in the Population Rules. Not produced by payroll. DIAN publishes NO XSD, NO cahier des charges and NO import template for Form 350. DIAN Resolution 000227 of 2025 art. 1.2.2.26 para. 1 says only that filers must use 'los Services Informaticos dispuestos por la entidad, utilizando el Electronic Signature Instrument (IFE)', and that DIAN 'pondra a disposicion el Form numero 350 en forma virtual en la pagina web'. Contrast the electronic payroll, which has a published XSD and a SOAP contract.

For CON AGREEMENT rows the rate comes from the applicable double-tax treaty and may be lower than 20%, or nil. Mercans applies treaty relief ONLY on written client instruction supported by a residence certificate.

From casilla 46 of the RUT, per DIAN Resoluciones 000114 of 21 December 2020, 001232 of 16 September 2022 and 000086 of 24 May 2023. The chosen code drives the self-withholding rate auto-filled into casilla 28 under DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.6.8.

DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.6.1.13.2.33 as set by Decree 2229 of 2023. NIT ending 1 files on the 7th business day, ending 2 on the 8th, and so on to ending 0 on the 16th. Contrast PILA, which is keyed to the last TWO digits and runs from the 2nd to the 16th business day.

The casilla also sweeps in fees, services and commissions paid to NATURAL persons that are withheld under the art. 383 table (ET art. 383 para. 2, added by Law 2277 of 2022 art. 8). Payroll supplies only the EMPLOYMENT component; the boundary with casilla 79 / 95 is a client-specific classification that must be agreed and documented at implementation.
Colombia has no employer year-end reconciliation, so an error here is corrected only by a corrective return, not by a December true-up.

Filing an all-zero return is not an error, but it creates a record that must then be corrected if a late payment is discovered. Prefer not filing where the exemption genuinely applies, and document the decision.

DIAN Concept 011108 of 29 June 2026 expressly rejects withholding under art. 383 from day one in anticipation of future residence, even on a contract exceeding 183 days. Withholding is determined at the moment of each payment on the status then held. There is no payroll true-up; the employee reconciles on their own return.

The distinguishing evidence is the place-of-work country carried on the electronic payroll (NIE050). Keep the two records consistent: a document showing LugarTrabajoPais other than CO for a non-resident should produce no Form 350 line.

Where an employee's withholding is corrected downward in a later month - a retroactive change to the art. 387 deductions, a cancelled payment, or an arithmetic error - report the reversal in casilla 129 of the month in which the correction is made, rather than correcting the earlier return. Where the month's withholding is insufficient to absorb the credit, the instruction guide permits carrying it to the immediately following periods.
Both blank on an initial return; both populated on a corrective one. Casilla 26 must carry the casilla-4 form number of the return being corrected.
Where the treaty assigns taxing rights to the residence state the rate may be reduced or nil - but Mercans applies treaty relief only on written client instruction with a residence certificate.
Would be populated where an earlier month's withholding is corrected downward.
